capabilities: insert dates via a trigger character and calendar popup
resolve relative date shortcuts like +3d and -1w
switch between output formats from the popup
append weekday text with customizable layout
extras: The plugin listing carries the notice: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly insert dates at the cursor in a chosen format or via relative offsets while typing.
summary: Trigger-based date picker that summons a mini calendar when you type @ in a note to pick a date and insert it in a chosen format.
